messages:
Morgan: heads up — intake request: Aquila-30B (30B dense, RoPE, tokenizer=sacremoses). Need rapid quant triage + bring-up checklist. Primary goal: ~2x cost reduction vs fp16 while keeping instr-follow quality high. :rocket:
Ayan: got it. any data/safety constraints? private customer data involved?
Morgan: no PII, public benchmark + internal eval sets only. evals: eval-suite/instruction_1k + regression_prompts (conv, code, summarization).
Zoe: proposed fast-plan: 1) fp16 baseline perf & quality (latency/throughput/PPL) 2) int8 calibration (per-channel KL) 3) try fp8-hybrid (attention/kV) if int8 drops too much 4) prepare gguf packaging + metadata for Private deploy. Keep it minimal for fast iteration. :eyes:
Cassie: I'll queue baseline runs on p4d with batch=1 and tokens=512. ETA ~2h.
QuantBot: job queued (id=6723) — baseline fp16 run started on p4d. ETA ~2h.
Morgan: calibration heuristics: use ~2k random instruction-like samples for int8 KL, per-channel symmetric for weights, act quant with layerwise minmax+KL; leave layernorms & rotary params in fp32.
Ayan: recommend trying per-layer bias correction after first pass — helped on last decoder-head regressions. Also capture logits for 100 eval prompts for detailed drift analysis.
Zoe: calibration config (quick copy): ```calibration: {"samples":2000, "strategy":"layerwise-kl", "weight_q":"per_channel_sym", "act_q":"minmax-kl", "skip_layernorm":true, "bias_correction":false}```
Cassie: I'll run int8-calib then baseline int8 eval. If drops exceed gates, I'll flip on bias_correction=true and re-run.
Morgan: define quality gates: instruction-F1 drop <=6% vs fp16, PPL increase <=12%, and no >3 obvious hallucination cases in 500-sample manual spot-check. If fail, attempt fp8-hybrid where attention & KV use fp8 and heads stay int8/fp16.
Ayan: logging/packaging: gguf export preferred for private deployments. Required metadata fields: model_id, commit_hash, quant_config, baseline_fp16_hash, calib_sample_hash, eval_suite_hash. Keep a short changelog in metadata.
Zoe: rollout plan: canary to Dedicated (2 nodes) at 1% traffic, 24h observation with token-diff alerts and latency SLOs. Auto-fallback to baseline model on >5% error or >2x latency.
Cassie: action items assigned: 1) I run baseline + int8 calib jobs and post job ids/results here. 2) @Zoe will prepare gguf export script + metadata template. 3) @Ayan will prepare the bias-correction experiment.
DevEx: FYI — add quickstart snippet for internal docs: ```python
from redwood_inference import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate(model=\"aquila-30b-gguf\", prompt=\"Tell a short story.\")
```
Morgan: thanks all. Cassie please @mention when initial results are in. We'll triage next steps in this thread. :thumbsup:
